stories.title: Big Game of the Week: Enumclaw vs. Mount Tahoma results
stories.summary: Every Friday night, KING 5 will highlight local high school football teams around the region with the Big Game of the Week livestream.

stories.title: Marysville man held in investigation of body found in yard waste container
stories.summary: A man is under investigation for allegedly moving a woman's body into a yard waste container in Marysville.

stories.title: Court order puts former Hoquiam hotel nonprofit purchased in receivership
stories.summary: The Department of Commerce is asking the nonprofit to provide additional information about how it spent two state grants.

stories.title: Lynnwood weighs round-the-clock speed cameras: Safety push or money grab?
stories.summary: Lynnwood may run school-zone speed cameras 24/7 and add two more. The mayor says it’s about safety and money; critics call it a grift.

stories.title: 3 charged in plot to secretly administer abortion medication to pregnant Bellingham woman
stories.summary: Prosecutors allege a man conspired with two other people to secretly administer abortion pills to his pregnant ex-fiancée in Whatcom County.

stories.title: Company faces $10 million in state penalties for deadly tank rupture
stories.summary: On May 26, a tank at the Nippon Dynawave plant holding nearly 1 million gallons of a caustic liquid, known as white liquor, collapsed.

stories.title: Nippon Dynawave fined over $10M for 'egregious' safety violations; investigators refer criminal charges
stories.summary: The findings of the workplace safety investigation are part of a larger effort to uncover exactly what went wrong that day.

stories.title: Vancouver man charged after wife says he handled a burrito and rubbed gluten on her face
stories.summary: The woman told police her husband handled a microwaved burrito with his bare hands before rubbing them on her face.

stories.title: Killing seals and sea lions across the ocean is unlikely to help salmon, study finds
stories.summary: A bipartisan bill would give Washington and eligible tribes more leeway to kill seals and sea lions that threaten vulnerable salmon runs.

stories.title: US Forest Service releases records on 1982 'Bigfoot' tracks found in Mill Creek watershed
stories.summary: Investigators checked two sites in the Mill Creek watershed, where the tracks appeared in short stretches.

stories.title: Seattle's council-approved budget includes medical debt relief, restored firefighter funding
stories.summary: The Seattle City Council votes Friday on a budget that would reverse firefighter cuts, address a backlog of criminal cases and expand shelter capacity.

stories.title: Everett man convicted in 2023 vehicular homicide arrested for DUI
stories.summary: Police say Gidney’s license had been suspended since June 2024 following his vehicular homicide conviction.
